bmt-2018-spring-algebra-tiebreaker-01.prompt: A train accelerates at 10 mph per minute, and decelerates at 20 mph per minute. The train's maximum speed is 300 mph. What is the shortest amount of time that the train could take to travel 500 miles, if it has to be stationary at both the start and end of its trip? Please give your answer in minutes.

bmt-2018-spring-algebra-tiebreaker-02.prompt: Suppose $2$ cars are going into a turn the shape of a half-circle. Car 1 is traveling at $50$ meters per second and is hugging the inside of the turn, which has radius $200$ meters. Car 2 is trying to pass Car 1 going along the turn, but in order to do this, he has to move to the outside of the turn, which has radius $210$. Suppose that both cars come into the turn side by side, and that they also end the turn being side by side. What was the average speed of Car 2, in meters per second, throughout the turn?

bmt-2018-spring-algebra-tiebreaker-03.reviewNote: The official key gives 2, but the sum equals (2^2018-1)/3, which is 1 mod 3 (checked by exact computation).
